turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste Sharma uncle, this is Rohan from the city. How is your health these days?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, Rohan! I am doing fine beta, just a little bit of knee pain lately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is just old age, uncle. Please make sure you are doing the physiotherapy exercises daily.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I try, but sometimes I forget. How is everything with you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything is good. I was thinking of visiting Jaipur next month for the Diwali holidays.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That would be wonderful. Will you stay at the hotel or come to our house?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will definitely come to your house. I really miss your wife's homemade sweets.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: She will be very happy. When exactly are you arriving?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Probably around the tenth. I have already booked my tickets.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Good, good. Do you need me to arrange anything for your stay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No need for that, but I did want to tell you that I sent twelve thousand rupees to your account for the temple donation we discussed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, you remembered that? I will check my passbook tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No rush, uncle. Just take care of yourself and I will see you soon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Bless you, beta. I will be waiting for you.
